title: Advanced Tools for Linkage Disequilibrium Decay and Functional Mapping
text: LDdecay optimized R package designed processing, analyzing, generating publication-ready visualizations global genome-wide Linkage Disequilibrium (LD) decay, binned empirical decay curves, regional LD block structure maps, fast overlapping variant--gene mapping standardized GFF3 annotations.

title: Advanced Tools for Linkage Disequilibrium Decay and Functional Mapping
text: Global LD Decay Model: Fits classical genetic non-linear least squares (NLS) regression curve ($r^2 \\sim 1/(1 + C \\times d)$) millions marker combinations using optimized sliding physical window. Empirical Binned Decay Curves: Smooths groups dense pairwise data custom intervals (e.g., 10kb windows) using Cartesian coordinate zooms entirely avoid edge boundaries cropping spikes. Regional Block Plots & Heatmaps: Generates publication-ready Haploview-style inverted triangle matrices local area--interest annotations flanking candidate regions. Ultra-Fast Variant Feature Scanner: Maps target variant coordinates GFF3 structural genomic annotations using vector-optimized memory management.

Significant SNPs can also displayed vertical reference lines short labels. lower panel displays pairwise LD inverted triangular representation, x-axis corresponds physical genomic position y-axis represents half physical distance marker pairs. function designed investigating candidate genomic regions surrounding significant GWAS markers can used evaluate whether significant variants located within near genes potentially relevant functional annotations. function performs following workflow: Calculates SNP-specific pairwise LD around focal SNP using         plot_single_snp_ld. Validates marker map GFF3-derived annotation table. Standardizes chromosome identifiers Gm01,         Gm02, ..., Gm20 format. Selects markers located requested chromosome within         specified genomic region. Converts pairwise LD matrix long format retains         one triangular half pairwise comparisons. Extracts gene models overlapping selected genomic region. Searches gene annotation fields using gene_pattern         identify candidate genes. Assigns genes non-overlapping horizontal tracks. Assigns candidate-gene labels non-overlapping vertical lanes. Adds user-defined significant SNPs reference lines labels. Constructs shared physical-position scale gene         LD panels. Combines gene LD panels using patchwork. Candidate genes identified using regular expression applied available annotation fields Name, ID, Note, Description, Dbxref, Ontology_term. Therefore, users can adapt function investigate different gene families biological pathways changing gene_pattern gene_name. LD panel uses physical midpoint marker pair horizontal coordinate half physical marker distance vertical coordinate. produces triangular representation similar commonly used LD-region visualizations.

code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(LDdecay)  # Define the focal genomic region focal_snp <- "ss715620779" chromosome <- "Gm03"  # Define candidate-gene annotation pattern gene_pattern <- "ABC-2/plant PDR ABC transporter|ABC|PDR transporter" gene_name <- "ABC/PDR Transport"  # Generate LD and gene annotation plot result <- plot_snp_ld_region_and_genes(   map = map,   geno = geno,   gff_table = gff_table,   chromosome = chromosome,   focal_snp = focal_snp,   ld_window = 360000,   gene_pattern = gene_pattern,   gene_name = gene_name )  # Display the composite plot result$plot  # View candidate genes result$candidate_genes  # View pairwise LD data head(result$ld_data) } # }
